observation_summary: The StringUtils.containsAny method incorrectly matches Unicode supplementary characters because it treats them as individual 16-bit characters rather than as surrogate pairs.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves rewriting the internal loop logic of the containsAny method to correctly identify and validate Unicode surrogate pairs. This is a procedural change to the search algorithm to handle supplementary characters correctly, rather than a simple guard or initialization fix.
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows a rewrite of the inner loop logic in StringUtils.containsAny.
The diff adds logic to check for high surrogate characters and verify the subsequent character in the pair.
The bug report states that the method incorrectly matches supplementary characters by treating them as individual characters.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix adds conditional checks, these checks are part of a fundamental change to the search algorithm's logic to correctly handle surrogate pairs, not just a missing guard.
